turns.assessment: The critical equipment alarm is localized to trx.och205.a and is followed by loss of its receiver monitoring, while the far-end trx.och205.z reports OCH_LOS. The channel also disappears at downstream OCMs, whereas the intervening amplifiers show no power, gain, or pump change. A card failure at trx.och205.a uniquely explains both its local unit-down behavior and loss of its transmitted channel at the far end.

proposals.rationale: The explicit EQPT_CARD_FAIL alarm, loss of valid local receiver telemetry, far-end OCH_LOS, and disappearance of och205 downstream from S14 match the documented CARD_FAIL effects. Stable amplifier instrumentation argues against a line-system failure.
A failed transmitter would explain the downstream channel loss and far-end OCH_LOS, but not the card-fail alarm or loss of local receive monitoring.
